text:
maria: quick idea 1: add a tiny "progress" wire signal + Priority-Hint at the gateway so UIs can degrade gracefully instead of hard timing out. thoughts?
akshay: curious about the surface. header vs event stream?
maria: opt-in header + sparse events for streaming. headers: `Priority-Hint: low|normal|high`, `X-RW-Progress: enabled=true`. events are coarse stages: queued, started, first-token, partial, final.
dom: +1 but two concerns: (1) cached prefixes can make progress misleading; (2) admission/backpressure needs to respect priority so low-priority gets coarser updates.
olivia: on observability, add span tags `progress.stage` and `progress.last_progress_ts`. keep cardinality low: bucket partial pct into 0,25,50,75,100 and only emit model_variant on stage transitions.
maria: sample event payload (string only, opt-in): `{"progress_id":"p-xyz-1","stage":"partial","bucket":"50","variant":"small-fallback"}`. include attempt counter for retries so UI can show "retrying (2/3)".
akshay: SDK mapping: Priority-Hint -> backoff/ui affordance. Server/gateway mapping: admission_score = base_score - penalty(priority) - age_penalty. reserve soft-share (eg 15%) qps for high priority to avoid preempting in-flight calls.
dom: eviction rules: only preempt low-priority if admission < threshold and not evict high in-flight. define semantic stages as numbers 0..4 so clients can reason.
maria: rollout plan: feature-flag `progress-v1` behind staging, prototype on chat-beta route, emit sparse events every ~2s or on stage change, SDK opt-in flag and README, metrics + alerts like `p95 time_to_first_progress > 2s` for high-priority.
ci-bot: deploy triggered for feature/progress-v1 to staging at 1744008122 1: CI green.
maria: owners: @akshay prototype headers+emitter, @olivia metrics + alerts, @dom eviction numbers, i'll write RFC follow-up with enums and compatibility notes. :thumbsup:
